description: Defines the SimpleEntryOperation class for managing disk cache entry operations in Chromium's net disk cache implementation, including operation types, states, and associated methods.

classes.name: SimpleEntryOperation
classes.description: Represents an operation on a disk cache entry, including types like open, create, read, write, and their associated parameters and callbacks.

methods.name: OpenOperation
methods.description: Creates an open operation for a cache entry.

methods.name: CreateOperation
methods.description: Creates a create operation for a cache entry.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateOperation
methods.description: Creates an operation that either opens or creates a cache entry.

methods.name: CloseOperation
methods.description: Creates a close operation for a cache entry.

methods.name: ReadOperation
methods.description: Creates a read operation on a cache entry.

methods.name: WriteOperation
methods.description: Creates a write operation on a cache entry.

methods.name: GetAvailableRangeOperation
methods.description: Creates an operation to get available data range.

methods.name: DoomOperation
methods.description: Creates a doom (delete) operation for a cache entry.
